messages:
Zoe: Heads-up — billing saw an edge case where card declines show a huge modal. Thinking we should switch to a compact banner with a clear CTA and a keyboard-focusable 'Update billing' button. Screenshot attached.
Marcus: Agree on compact banner. Modal feels too interruptive for product teams on a tight task flow.
Anya: +1 to banner. Can we also include inline help copy pointing to invoices? Something like: 'Payment failed — invoices are available in Billing > History.'
Sam: Quick nit: 'Payment failed' is scary. Maybe 'Payment could not be processed' or 'Payment declined' is clearer? Also we need an aria-live region for the message so screen readers announce it.
Olivia: Love the accessibility callout. For CTA copy: 'Update payment method' (verb-first) vs 'Manage payment' — which is better for clarity?
Marcus: I vote 'Update payment method' — more direct, less ambiguous.
Anya: For the explanatory line I suggest: 'We couldn't process your last charge. Update your payment method to avoid service interruption.' Shorter variant: 'We couldn't process your last charge. Update your payment method to keep your account active.'
Zoe: Both good. UX question: do we show the banner persistently until a successful payment, or auto-dismiss after X days with a subtle toast?
Sam: Persist until resolved, but keep it dismissible with a 'Remind me later' action that sets a 24h snooze. Important: dismissal must still be keyboard-accessible and announced to SRs.
Olivia: Also, currency and amount info could help: 'We couldn't process your ${amount} charge on ${date}.' But be cautious with PII — only last 4 of the card.
Marcus: Implementation note from infra: we can show last4 and amount, but we need to flag it so Private deployments can opt-out. Make that a config flag.
Zoe: Copy variants to review (short list):
1) Primary (concise): 'Payment declined — update your payment method to avoid interruption.' CTA: 'Update payment method' Secondary: 'Remind me later'
2) Friendly tone: 'Looks like your last payment didn’t go through. Update your payment method to keep things running.' CTA: 'Update payment'
3) Minimal: 'Payment failed. Update payment method.' CTA: 'Update'
Anya: Prefer variant 1 for enterprise clarity.
Sam: Accessibility requirements to capture:
- banner in a role="status" aria-live="polite" region when it appears
- focus trap NOT needed; only focus the CTA on keyboard navigation
- 'Remind me later' should be a button with aria-pressed="false" state if toggled
- Ensure color contrast meets AA for the banner text and CTA
Olivia: Also confirm that the banner uses semantic <button> elements, not anchor tags, and has visible focus outlines (no custom invisible outlines).
Marcus: Small localization note: keep copy under ~80 chars for most locales, avoid contractions for legal clarity (so use 'did not' instead of 'didn't' in some languages).
Zoe: Great. Action items:
- @Marcus & @Sam: implement banner component with accessible live region and snooze behavior (owner: Marcus).
- @Anya & @Olivia: finalize copy + i18n variants, include legal-safe phrasing (owner: Anya).
- @Zoe: mock updated banner in figma and add examples for short/long invoice lines.
- @design-bot: please add a checklist item to the release notes for billing UI changes.
design-bot: Task created: BILLING-UI-342 — "Payment banner copy & a11y". Assigned: Marcus, Anya. Due: 2024-07-12.
Anya: I'll post final copy in this thread once we confirm legal.
Marcus: I'll ping infra about the Private opt-out flag.
Zoe: Thanks team — aiming to ship this with next patch release. :thumbsup:
Olivia: One last microcopy tweak suggestion: change 'Remind me later' to 'Remind me in 24h' to set clear expectation. Thoughts?
Sam: Prefer explicit timing. 'Remind me in 24 hours' is slightly longer but clearer for accessibility.
Anya: OK final call: 'Remind me in 24 hours'. I'll update the variants when I post the legal-approved copy.
Zoe: Perfect — thread closed once Anya posts the final strings."
